label.tr: GA4 geliri ile arka ofis cirosu

text.en: purchase is not sent on mobile Safari since release v4.12 (9 Oct): the thank-you page loads the tag before dataLayer is ready.
text.tr: v4.12 sürümünden (9 Eki) beri mobil Safari’de purchase gitmiyor: teşekkür sayfası tag’i dataLayer hazır olmadan yüklüyor.

sql.expected:
-- metric revenue v2
SELECT
  date AS day,
  device,
  SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY day, device
ORDER BY day, device
sql.measured:
-- metric ga4_revenue v1
SELECT
  date AS day,
  device,
  SUM(ga4_revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY day, device
ORDER BY day, device

label.en: Google Ads conversions against back-office orders
label.tr: Google Ads dönüşümleri ile arka ofis siparişleri
Google Ads kaynaklı arka ofis siparişi

sql.expected:
-- metric orders v3
SELECT
  date AS day,
  device,
  SUM(orders) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel = 'google_ads'
GROUP BY day, device
ORDER BY day, device
sql.measured:
-- metric platform_conversions v1
SELECT
  date AS day,
  device,
  SUM(platform_conversions) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel = 'google_ads'
GROUP BY day, device
ORDER BY day, device
